CustomField.description: Derived: true only while the job is enabled and today falls inside the Start Date / End Date window. Mirrors AJOWindow in Apex, so list views, reports and the dispatcher all agree on what "active" means.
CustomField.formula: AJO_Enabled__c && ( ISBLANK(AJO_StartDate__c) || AJO_StartDate__c <= TODAY() ) && ( ISBLANK(AJO_EndDate__c) || TODAY() <= AJO_EndDate__c )
CustomField.label: Active
